info.title: LicenseRail API
info.description: Licensing API. Authenticate with 'Authorization: Bearer <API key or access token>'. Live/Test: API keys are bound to one environment; access tokens use the X-Environment header (default test).

post.summary: Create a product
Add a feature (entitlement) to a product

delete.summary: Delete a feature (also removes it from licenses)

post.summary: Create a customer

get.summary: List licenses (filters: productId, customerId, status, q, expiringWithinDays)

post.summary: Create one or more licenses (quantity up to 50); returns a list

patch.summary: Update a license (JSON merge patch; expiresAt null = perpetual)

delete.summary: Delete a license that was never activated

post.summary: Revoke a license (irreversible; devices are refused on their next refresh)
Suspend a license (reversible)
Resume a suspended license
Move a license to another customer (active devices are unaffected)
Bulk action on licenses: set_expiry, suspend, resume, delete (unused only)
Free a device's seat (the device is locked on its next refresh)

get.summary: Current organization, environment, role and balance
The environment's license-signing public key (PEM), to embed in apps
Machine-readable events (same payloads as webhooks); type filter supports 'license.*'
Human-readable activity history (paged with 'before' = last id)
License and device counts for the environment
API requests of the last 30 days

post.summary: Create an API key (Live keys only from the dashboard); the secret is shown once
Approve (dashboard session only)
Reject (dashboard session only)
End-to-end activation in Test with a simulated device, then frees the device
Ready-to-paste integration code for an SDK, with this environment's public key
Create a webhook endpoint; the signing secret (whsec_…) is shown once

patch.summary: Update a webhook endpoint (url, eventTypes, enabled)

post.summary: Rotate the signing secret (the old one also signs for 24 hours)
Send a ping event to the endpoint
Send a delivery again now

get.summary: Prepaid balance, days-left estimate and auto top-up settings
Usage per day, environment and meter
Money movements: starting credit, top-ups, manual credits

post.summary: Start a Stripe Checkout top-up (Owner)

apiKey.description: Secret or restricted API key (lr_test_…, lr_live_…, lr_rk_…) or a CLI/OAuth access token.
